subject: English
guide_solution: Answering questions (a) Folk art is an indigenous art practiced by the people for their own consumption and use. The word 'indigenous' means belonging naturally. (b) In pre-historic period people had liberty in food gathering, agricultural activity. They would pass simple rural lite in their own way. (c) To me it seems that folk art is losing its place because of cultural aggression. (d) The folk art of early Bangladesh illustrates the representation of hope, aspiration and sense of beauty of the rural people of Bangladesh. These art symbolize the traditional sense of beauty of the rural people and, their aesthetic value etc. (e) Yes. I support the idea because our folk art is the source of pure and simple vigor of the rural Bengali folk. It has a deep rooted historical strength to exist for a long time.

subject: English
guide_solution: Summary Bangladesh is a nation of cultural diversity. Folk art is one of them. It has a historical origin. It's a kind of art belonging naturally to our lifestyle. The art is predominantly concerned with beauty and the understanding of beautiful things. The art refreshes our mind with simplicity and purity. In fact, it is an embodiment of symbolizing traditional sense of beauty of the rural folks and depicting the simple life in rural Bengal.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : See Govt. S.C. subject: English
stimulus: Choose the correct answer from the alternatives. 1×7=7 (a) Which of the following has the closest meaning of the word 'indigenous' used in line-2? (i) A group of people belong to a particular place rather than coming to it from somewhere else. (ii) A group of people of the same race and with the same customs religion, language etc. living in a particular area. (iii) Relating to the original people. (iv) people for different races. (b) What does the expression 'art-effort' in line 3 mean? (i) Trying to develop (ii) Trying to develop an art (iii) Artistic art (iv) Demoralizing an art (c) Which of the following best describes 'pre-historic period?' (i) A period related with history (ii) Ancient history (iii) connected with the time in history before information was written down (iv) connected with the time in history after information was written down. (d) Which of the following words describe 'aesthetic' best according to the given passage? (i) A view of wide area do land and things (ii) A panoramic view of things (iii) Made in an artistic way and beautiful to look at. (iv) Concerned with beauty and art and the understanding of beautiful things. (e) Which of the following statement(s) is/are true about Magical Art? (i) The people believe in secret power of God. (ii) Wonderful art. (iii) Art which are done by magic. (iv) Believing in secret power of God and Goddesses. (f) In line 2 of the last paragraph the phrase 'folk-art' mean . (i) The art which in simple and pure. (ii) The are which refreshes our mind with simplicity and purity. (iii) The art related with village people. (iv) The people who like to folk art. (g) What is the main purpose of the author of this passage? (i) To introduce to folk-art and its importance. (ii) To describe folk-art and develop it. (iii) To revive the folk-art (iv) To justify the folk-art and the modern art. Answer the following questions. 2×5=10 (a) What is folk-art? (b) "In the pre-historic period men were free and independent in their everyday life." Why has it said? Explain in 2/3 sentences. (c) Do you thing that folk-art is losing its place? Why and why not? (d) Describe the glorious folk-art of early Bangladesh. (e) Do you support the idea that the folk-art of Bangladesh will exist for a long time? Why/Why not? Explain in 2/3 sentences. Write a summary of the passage in no more than 75 to 85 words. 10 Read the passage carefully and complete the table below with information from the passage. 1×5=5 SSC English Barack Obama was born to a white American mother and a black Kenyan father on 04 August 1961 in Hawaii, USA. When his father returned to Kenya, his mother married another man. So, Obama was brought up by his grandparents. He completed primary & secondary education at Punabou, Hawaii's top academy. Obama attended Columbia University and later he attended Harvard Law School. In 1990, he became the first African-American editor of the Law Review. He also began teaching at the Chicago Law School. In 2004, Obama was elected Senator to US Senate as a Democrat. He gained national attention by giving a well-received speech at the Democratic National Convention in Boston. In 2008, he ran for the President and he won. In January 2009, he was sworn as the 44th President of the USA. He was re-elected to a second term in November 2012. Name of event Place Year/Times Achievement Born (i) ............ Studied law (ii)........ Taught law (iii)....... (iv) .......... in 1990 in 2009 (v) ...........
guide_solution: Information transfer (i) 04 August 1961; (ii) Harvard Law School; (iii) Chicago Law School; (iv) became the first African-American editor of the Law Review; (v) president of the USA.
